title: aspidium fragile
intro: Aspidium fragile, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help in reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium fragile include its ability to act as an adaptogen, which helps the body to adapt to stress and promotes overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
